name: morsel_query
description: Query local files and Go symbols with a GraphQL selection. Request only needed fields. Cost is measured by the declared local meter, not provider billing. Set consumer only for a shared context; repeated complete text may become {$crumb,v,d}. Use fresh or morsel_expand to recover text.

budget.description: Local meter budget; overrides query directive.

consumer.description: Explicit context owner; omit to disable crumbs.

name: morsel_schema
description: Discover query roots, types and fields. Optional search narrows the overview and shows paths from the root. Output is a compact textual guide, not a full GraphQL introspection result.

name: morsel_expand
description: Recover current content from a $crumb token, or select fields of an entity ID. Entity IDs require select; fragment tokens recover their original field by default. Always bypasses crumb suppression, subject to access policy and local budget.

budget.description: Local meter budget; overrides query directive.

consumer.description: Explicit context owner; omit to disable crumbs.
